neighbours.label: ' because' explaining why something bad or odd is tolerated: 'can get away with it because', 'wasn't worried because' (output promotes because, due)
fire: The firm can get away with it because customers are loyal.
I wasn't upset because I knew it was normal.
They can afford the debt because savers trust them.
She wasn't scared because she knew the dog.
He can skip class because his grades are high.
I wasn't surprised because I had read the report.
The town can ignore it because the budget is full.
We weren't concerned because the test was early.
quiet: The firm can get away with it although customers are few.
I wasn't upset and I knew it was normal.
They can afford the debt but savers doubt them.
She wasn't scared and she knew the dog.
He can skip class but his grades are low.
I wasn't surprised and I had read the report.
The town can ignore it although the budget is low.
We weren't concerned and the test was early.

notes: Card: ' because' 11, ' that' 3, '.' 3. Probes: ' because' 0.75, 0.51; 'although' 0.13; 'went home because of' 0.01. So not every ' because'. One near-miss token ' worried' reached 0.21.
